Q180.reason: Photographs need a witness who can testify they fairly and accurately depict the subject, and the photographer only confirmed she took them, not that they show the ruptured tank accurately; chain of custody applies to fungible items like drugs, not photos.

Q181.reason: The two-year, 50-mile, any-aspect non-compete is likely unreasonable and unenforceable, and the $1,500 penalty tied to it falls with it, while the independent salary and termination terms are severable and stand.

Q182.reason: The neighbor was alive when the remainder was created, so her fee simple remainder vested and passed under her will to the charity, leaving the friend a life estate and the daughter with no interest to convey.
